idea-plugin.name: Velo Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Velo Assistant is a guided project bootstrapper for Flutter developers, built to feel like a native part of Android Studio.
It helps you: • Choose your Flutter SDK version and project location from a single, simple dialog. • Define your application id / package name and basic project metadata. • Pick VeloLabs feature blocks and starting templates that match what you are building. • Generate a clean Flutter project with structure, imports, and dependencies wired in.
Under the hood, Velo Assistant keeps all feature blocks and templates aligned with current Flutter practices and package versions, so new projects start from code that is up to date, readable, and easy to extend.

action.description: Create a new Flutter project from VeloLabs feature blocks and templates
